mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, conditions at City Hall are overcast with a temperature of 45 degrees. We are under a waxing crescent moon, and you can expect an overnight low of 37 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city is moving forward with the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to ensure year-round accessibility, with a public meeting scheduled for December 8. Additionally, if you are interested in local leadership, candidate registration packets are available for the 2027 spring election with a deadline of January 5.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or a pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at trivia nights at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, or Hop Haus, and check out the festivities at ART House 360.

In a report covering incidents from October 18 to October 24, officers responded to a situation on October 25 where a 40-year-old man was taken into custody for an O W I after being found unresponsive in his vehicle.
Treat yourself to today's delicious flavor, Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
